topic: Open-ended zero-duration single media edit in a fragmented MP4 init segment
source: owned_mp4_impl.rs parse_track currently rejects every zero-duration elst entry; W3C permits a single rate-one duration-zero media edit spanning subsequent fragments.
next_steps: Author independent V0/V1 fMP4 controls/witnesses and prove exact before behavior, preserving existing malformed regular-file and blank-edit refusals.

Audit every edit consumer: native video, audio, export, probe and planners. Preserve zero as an open-ended state or resolve with exact media endpoints, rather than silently quantizing it into integer movie duration.
Cover trimmed start, positive composition offsets, differing/fractional movie clocks, missing media, budgets, seek and repeated EOF before accepting.
caution: No fix or reproducer exists yet for this candidate. Do not count a field-check variant or a partial one-consumer workaround as completion.
